title: Restock a wall-mounted twin-roll tissue dispenser and make the remaining roll available first
instruction: Restock the twin-roll tissue dispenser and leave it ready to dispense the remaining roll first.
context: Janitors and cleaners routinely replenish public washroom supplies. Keeping the usable remaining roll while fitting a refill avoids waste and leaves the dispenser ready for the next user.
setup:
Coordinates m: origin midway between arm bases; +x forward, +y left, z up. Arms start READY, fingers shut, bases (0,+/-0.305,0.750). Two wooden counter platforms, each 1.10 x 0.445 x 0.060 m, have top z=0.7475 and centres (0.360, +/-0.4275, 0.7175), leaving a 0.410 m service gap. Each platform has four steel legs, 0.060 x 0.060 x 0.6875 m. The upper wooden mounting board is 0.020 x 0.560 x 0.4205 m, centred at (0.516,0,0.95775), secured rigidly to the bench support; the wooden floor-service backboard is 0.020 x 0.410 x 0.7475 m, centred at (0.516,0,0.37375). Floor and supports are physical.

The vertical, unbranded twin-roll cabinet is 0.490 m wide, 0.3005 m high and 0.132 m deep in the closed case, with rear face x=0.500 and bottom z=0.7875. Fixed side/top walls surround a side-hinged ABS front cover, estimated complete assembly mass 0.60 kg, starting 90 degrees open about a vertical hinge at (0.370,0.245,0.7875). Its physical latch has a POM-C cam bolt, 19 x 14 x 12 mm triangular-prism envelope with the integral 6 mm square load tip inside that envelope; total solid mass 2.25036 g, spring 400 N/m, damping 0.8 N s/m, and 18 mm travel. These are engineering estimates, not OEM measurements.

Two fixed horizontal supports, 77 mm across flats in the 24-sided CAD representation and 65 mm long, sit at y=+0.120 and -0.120, axis height z=0.93775, with rear shoulder x=0.489. Rolls turn freely around these supports by physical contact. The remaining roll starts on the y=-0.120 support: 115 mm outside diameter, 83.82 mm core opening, 86.36 mm width, mass 0.150 kg. The full refill starts on the cardboard platform at (0.34318,-0.520), top z=0.8075, with its axis horizontal: 223.52 mm outside diameter, 83.82 mm core opening, 86.36 mm width and mass 0.743891 kg. Remaining-roll dimensions/mass are estimates; refill follows cited TJ0922A specifications.

A continuous tissue tail, 86.36 mm wide and 350 mm long, remains attached to the remaining roll. It starts as a flat, stress-free sheet tangent to the inner upper side of the right old roll, 30 degrees above its inward horizontal radius. Its attached root line spans x=0.40264 to 0.48900, at y=-0.06934, z=0.96359 m. The 350 mm loose sheet extends diagonally left and down, with initial free edge at y=0.10566, z=0.66048 m, pre-threaded through the already open left outlet. The single 33-node root attachment is the only attachment; gravity, contact and self-collision remain active. This is a prepared maintenance reset. The two bottom apertures span x=0.396 to0.494, y=-0.225 to-0.015 and y=0.015 to0.225, at z=0.7875. A captured ABS sliding panel, 224 mm wide with 240 mm travel and a thumb tab, starts in the maintenance position covering the y<0 aperture and leaving the y>0 aperture open. The final service configuration puts the remaining roll at y=+0.120, the new roll at y=-0.120, exposes accessible remaining-roll tissue, and covers the new-roll aperture.

A loose aluminium closing tool, simulated mass 0.3140208 kg from its six stock-piece envelopes at 2,700 kg/m3, rests with origin (0.160,0.500,0.7675). It has a 60 x 40 x 30 mm contact foot, an 8 x 48 x 8 mm neck, a 28 x 8 x 8 mm bridge, an 8 x 12 x 15 mm riser, an 18 x 20 x 50 mm handle and a 50 x 80 x 5 mm base. The simulation treats its six contact solids as one rigid body; fabrication/ supplies a positive-area neck/bridge weld and the remaining welded joints. The tool is optional; full credit requires it clear of the dispenser. Fixed cabinet walls, supports and selector are ABS engineering equivalents; latch receiver and counter legs are steel, backboard/platforms wood, carton paperboard and closing tool aluminium. setup_manifest.json gives all original geometry/transforms; fabrication/ supplies parts, fasteners and assembly. Real joint/mounting hardware is idealized in simulation; prototype mass, drag and properties are unmeasured.
scoring: End-state score, except a real fall latches failure. Score 0 if either roll centre ever falls over 50 mm below the counter top, if the remaining roll finishes outside the cabinet, or if it is not seated left. Seated means rear axis within 6 mm axially and 6 mm radially of the support target, axis within 4 degrees. Otherwise: 0.25 for the remaining roll seated left; +0.20 for the refill seated right; +0.20 for cover within 2 degrees of shut and physical bolt returned within 3 mm; +0.15 for the panel fully exposing the remaining-roll aperture and blocking the refill aperture. +0.10 requires the same connected sheet attached within 2 mm, passing through the correct aperture, with one connected exposed terminal portion of at least 200 mm2 and its own continuous free edge spanning at least 20 mm. The qualifying portion lies outside and below the outlet within its vertical projection; its qualifying free-edge run is at least 20 mm below the outlet. Other corners may drape outside that projection. The complete terminal patch stays at least 4 mm above the actual floor. Final +0.10 requires both rolls, cover and panel below 10 mm/s and 0.25 rad/s, and all 630 robot collision pieces plus all six closing-tool pieces clear of device and paper by conservative 20 mm checks. Full 1.0 holds for 1 s with valid access and release. Natural sheet motion alone is not a failure. Invalid or incomplete geometry cannot earn full credit. Normal cover-closing speed is not a failure.
reset_notes: Reopen the cover to 90 degrees. Return the remaining roll to the right support and the refill to the cardboard platform. Preposition the manual selector to cover the right/refill aperture and leave the left aperture open. Keep the same 350 mm real loose tissue tail attached to the old roll along the declared inner-upper tangent root line, and thread the loose free edge through the open left aperture, matching the supplied initial geometry and settled reset screenshot. Do not add attachments or supports. Restore the loose closing tool and both arms to READY. The agent must transfer the old roll to the left support, fit the refill on the vacated right support, close/latch/release the cover and leave actual usable old-roll tissue. It need not move the already correctly positioned selector. The physical central gap and floor remain part of the reset.
fidelity: Original custom dispenser with fabrication drawings. Physical cam latch and selector; hinge/slide bearings and dampers are idealized. CAD adds documented mounting/guide hardware and a tool weld; their mass and drag are unmeasured. ABS cover0.60kg/POM bolt2.25036g and contact properties are estimates. Tissue:100um,28g/m2,E1MPa,nu0.25; winding and tearing omitted. A350mm root-attached loose tail starts pre-threaded through the left outlet. Native demos are simulation evidence.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0; complete demo: 1.0; complete independent repeat: 1.0.
